title: Situs inversus totalis with dextrocardia (rare presentation)

patient.name: Anita
patient.chief_complaint: Lower belly pain since last night, mostly on the left side.
patient.history: Pain started around the belly button and settled in the left lower abdomen. Nausea and reduced appetite, low-grade fever. Chronic sinus infections since childhood. She was told long ago that her heart is 'on the other side' but has never had further workup.

abd_llq.say: Ouch, right there on the left side!
abd_llq.rebound_say: Aaah! Worse when you take your hand away!

chest_r5ics.description: Apex beat and heart sounds are loudest on the RIGHT 5th intercostal space. Normal S1, S2.

chest_apex.description: Heart sounds faint on the left side.

teaching_points: Dextrocardia: apex beat on the right.
Appendicitis in situs inversus presents with LEFT lower quadrant pain, a classic diagnostic trap.
Kartagener syndrome (primary ciliary dyskinesia): sinusitis, bronchiectasis, situs inversus.
